events.title: ZooLights Free Admission Mondays
events.ageLabel: All ages. Every guest, kids included, needs a ticket
events.schedule: Mondays Nov 23, Nov 30, Dec 7 and Dec 14, 4:30–9pm (last entry 8pm)

registration.note: Free Monday tickets are released one week ahead at 11am CT. Tickets for Nov 23 drop Mon Nov 16. Every person in the group needs a ticket. Dec 21 and Dec 28 are not free nights.

events.description: Lincoln Park Zoo glows with holiday light displays every evening of the season. On most Mondays, entry is free with a reservation.
events.sourceNote: lpzoo.org ZooLights page: season Nov 20, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027, 4:30-9pm with last entry 8pm. Closed Nov 26, Dec 1, 8, 15, 24, 25. Free with required reservation on Mondays except Dec 21 and 28. 'Tickets for Free Admission Mondays will be released one week in advance at 11 a.m. CT.' Every individual including children must have a ticket. Other nights: fixed-date tickets $7-$12 in advance, $20 day-of or flexible. Monday session dates derived from the season dates and listed exceptions. opensAt is the release for the Nov 23 night (Nov 30 releases Nov 23, and so on). Address is the zoo's administrative address from the Hours & Location page.

events.title: ZooLights Sensory-Friendly Night

registration.note: Buy a dated ticket online before the visit. Every guest needs a ticket to enter. Tickets can be shown on a phone.

events.description: A calmer ZooLights evening. Blinking and moving lights are held still or slowed way down, and music is softened or turned off.
events.sourceNote: Date (Tuesday, November 24, ticket link carries date=2026-11-24), 4:30-9pm, $7, ticket required for all guests and the light and music changes confirmed on the lpzoo.org event page and the main ZooLights page. No age rule is given. Status 'open' is based on the live ticket link on the event page.

events.title: Lightscape
events.ageLabel: All ages. Kids 2 and under are free
events.schedule: Select nights Nov 13 to Jan 3 from 4:30pm. Sensory Night Dec 2. Family Nights Dec 9 and 16
events.priceLabel: Prices vary by date, some nights under $30. Free for kids 2 and under

registration.note: Timed tickets are sold in 15-minute entry windows. Buying early locks in the lowest price. Saturdays and nights near the holidays are in high demand.

events.description: A 1.3-mile illuminated trail with music and large light installations. Plan on 45 to 75 minutes. Strollers are welcome except on 21+ nights.
events.sourceNote: Season Nov 13, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027 from the chicagobotanic.org press release. Lightscape FAQ: most evenings 4:30-10:30pm (last entry 8:45pm), select dates 4:30-9:30pm (last entry 7:45pm), 15-minute entry windows, children 2 and younger free, strollers allowed except 21+ nights, about 1.3 miles and 45-75 minutes, Sensory Night Dec 2 (social story and free sensory backpacks), Family Nights Dec 9 and Dec 16, Saturdays and holiday dates in high demand, $3 fee on paid nonmember tickets. The press release describes Jingle Jam Family Nights with Santa. No exact prices or on-sale dates are published. Session ends omitted because closing time varies by date. Sessions list opening night plus the sensory and family nights only.

events.title: Illumination
events.schedule: Evenings from 4:30pm, Nov 14 to Jan 2. Sensory Night Tue Nov 17
events.priceLabel: Adults from $22, members from $17.60. Prices vary by date

registration.note: Timed tickets are on sale now, and popular dates and times sell out. The entry time is printed on each ticket. The Pine Whistle Railroad needs a separate ticket.

events.description: A one-mile paved trail of light displays among the trees, easy to roll with a stroller. Sensory Night has static lights, quieter music and fewer people.
events.sourceNote: mortonarb.org Illumination page: Sat Nov 14, 2026 through Sat Jan 2, 2027, opens each evening at 4:30pm, one-mile ADA paved path walkable and rollable for strollers, tickets sold while a date and time is not sold out, Sensory Night Tuesday Nov 17. Press release: adult tickets from $17.60 members and $22 nonmembers, member on-sale Oct 1 at 9am CT, public on-sale Oct 15 at 9am CT, Sensory Night is limited-capacity with static lights and lower-volume music. Closing time not stated, so session ends omitted.
